description: For a deductively closed theory \(T\), \([A]\in F_T\) exactly when \(A\in T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.mem_filterOfTheory.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf A ∈
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory T hT ↔
    A ∈ T
